jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

The Project Manager plays a critical role in orchestrating the end\-to\-end execution, client alignment, and operational delivery of Avalara’s voluntary compliance services engagements across multiple jurisdictions. As client transaction complexity, historical compliance exposure, and project volumes expand, this role ensures disciplined project governance, protects service delivery timelines, enforces project scope boundaries, and mitigates compliance risks.


This individual contributor operates as a Bar Raiser within Client Services — elevating project management rigor, proactively managing customer expectations, and leveraging artificial intelligence and automation tools to enhance operational speed, transparency, and service quality across the entire project lifecycle.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:
* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for assigned multi\-jurisdiction client portfolios, achieving 98–100% on\-time milestone and service level agreement performance.
* Manage client relationships and project governance with high professionalism, establishing structured communication rhythms, clear agendas, and prompt follow\-up documentation.
* Enforce project scope and customer accountability, ensuring clients provide requisite transactional data, taxability confirmations, and timely reviews without shifting data preparation burden onto project management.
* Maintain rigorous real\-time system documentation in Salesforce, Certinia, and Google Drive, including weekly task status updates, risk logs, and audit\-ready customer communication records.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Data Consultants, Tax Analysts, State Tax Authorities, Customer Account Managers, and Sales to resolve escalations and ensure seamless execution.
* Leverage approved artificial intelligence and productivity applications for basic operational functions, including drafting structured client updates, synthesizing meeting action items, and summarizing project statuses.
* Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and proactively recommend new tools, macros, or automation opportunities to technical and operations teams.
* Assist internal teams with user testing, validation, and feedback collection for newly developed or updated tools and workflows prior to full rollout.
* Continuously refine and document Standard Operating Procedures, project kickoff templates, and status reporting frameworks.


What You'll Need to be Successful:
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Accounting, Finance, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in project management, client service delivery, or professional services coordination.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent client projects, establish project timelines, monitor deliverables, and tenaciously solve problems to keep projects moving forward.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience managing executive and cross\-functional client relationships, facilitating meetings with structured agendas, and articulating project scope boundaries.
* Comfort using standard office applications (such as Google Workspace and Microsoft Office) and existing enterprise artificial intelligence tools for basic daily functions (such as summarization, text drafting, and task organization).
* Willingness to provide constructive feedback, suggest process improvements, and assist with testing new operational tools and workflows.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and time\-management skills with acute attention to detail and recordkeeping.

jobs.title: Food Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Foodsmart:**  

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.



Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.



Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases.



At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:



Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards.  

Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  

One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

  

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  


**About the Role:**  

Foodsmart seeks a service\-oriented Food Operations Analyst to join our dynamic, fast\-growing team on a full\-time basis. This role will serve as the primary coordinator of food delivery for members enrolled in our meal\-delivery and support programs. Through this role, your expertise in customer support and service excellence will ensure our members experience the highest level of compassion and care.


*We are hiring multiple Food Operations Analysts to join our growing team.*


### **You will:**

* Provide high\-quality customer support to our many existing and future members, from initial inquiry to ongoing program questions
* Utilize existing resources, tools, and team members to quickly address any member order fulfillment issues
* Ensure member orders are fulfilled accurately and to the highest quality standard
* Contribute suggestions to continue optimize the member ordering and fulfillment process
* Ability to support other key needs as defined

### **You are:**

* Compassionate about our members, many of whom rely on the food delivered to support them or their loved ones during difficult times
* Detail oriented, ensuring the food orders placed are accurate and timely
* Driven to support our members through quick yet thorough issue resolution
* Adaptable and ready to try new approaches as we onboard new clients and new processes \- a willingness to offer and implement even better solutions is always encouraged

### **You have:**

* High school diploma or GED required
* Minimum of 2 years work experience in customer support roles
* Self\-motivated and driven
* Strong computer proficiency including good knowledge of Microsoft/GSuite applications
* Preferred:
	+ Ability to troubleshoot and resolve client issues in real time
	+ Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and problem\-solving skills to resolve member issues efficiently
	+ Ability to be flexible to shifts in priorities and thrive in autonomous work environments

Role: Food Operations Analyst  

Location: Remote, USA  

Base Salary Range: $55,000 \- $60,000 \+ $5,000 annual bonus \+ benefits

jobs.title: Finance Operations Analyst (Korean Bilingual)
jobs.description:
**A little bit about us**

Bespin Global is a leading global Cloud \& AI MSP recognized in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for 8 consecutive years. We’ve been named the AWS MSP Partner of the Year globally and have earned multiple Google Partner of the Year awards!

We have 1,400\+ “Bespineers” across 16 offices in 10 countries—including the U.S., South Korea, Singapore, Dubai, Indonesia, China, and Japan—supporting over 4,500 customers worldwide.

We’re growing fast, and if you want to help enterprise clients solve complex challenges using the power of the cloud, this is the place for you. Our US team is fully remote, lean, and growing \- so the work you do is visible and it matters.

**We're looking for...**

A detail\-oriented and analytical Finance Operations Analyst to be a key player on our finance team. This isn’t a single\-lane analyst role. You will see the whole finance and operations function from billing, closing, forecasting, vendor \& budget management, and other various business operations. You will work directly with the leadership and our Korea office. If you have a passion for numbers, a desire to learn, and a proven ability to manage multiple financial tasks with precision, this is the role for you. You will be responsible for supporting the core financial functions of a dynamic and fast\-growing global tech company.

This is a fully US\-remote role, and candidates must be located within the continental United States.

**About the Role:**

As a **Finance Operations Analyst**, you will report to the **Senior Finance Manager** and will:

* Financial Insight and Planning: Build and maintain financial, sales, and pipeline dashboards, ensure CRM data is current and accurate, analyze spending against budget, and help drive the annual budget and forecast.
* Cloud Billing \& Revenue Operations: Own the monthly billing cycle for our AWS, GCP, and Azure business. Reconcile cloud vendor charges against customer billing and resolve discrepancies, credits, and customer or vendor inquiries.
* Accounts Payable, Receivable \& Payments: Manage day\-to\-day AP/AR processes, including vendor invoices, payment requests and remittances, customer invoicing, collections, and payment application issues.
* Monthly Close \& Reporting: Support the month\-end and year\-end closing of the books by preparing journal entries, reconciling bank statements and general ledger accounts, and assisting in the preparation of financial statements.
* Budgeting \& Analysis: Assist in the annual budgeting and forecasting processes. Track and analyze departmental spending against budget, reporting on variances to the leadership team.
* KPI \& Performance Tracking: Maintain financial, sales, and pipeline dashboards, ensure CRM data is current and accurate, and provide analysis to support data\-backed decisions.
* Business Operations Support: Provide cross\-functional support for employee expenses, vendor onboarding, contract and subscription records, and other evolving operational needs. Identify process improvements and help implement scalable systems and controls.

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Must\-Have:**

* **Native\-level or full professional proficiency in written and spoken Korean.** You will communicate daily in Korean with our Korea office and work with Korean\-language financial, intercompany, and contract documents. **Korean proficiency will be assessed live during the first interview.**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* 2\-5 years of relevant experience in a finance, accounting, or operations role.
* A proactive, flexible, "get\-things\-done" mindset, with a willingness to take on responsibilities beyond a defined job scope and support evolving business needs.
* A strong desire to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to analyze data, automate routine tasks, and improve workflows, with sound judgment in validating outputs and handling sensitive information.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas).
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative team player with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions, and cultures.
* Authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role.

**Nice\-to\-Have:**

* Experience with QuickBooks and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn and effectively use new financial and operational tools.
* Work experience in the technology sector (e.g., Cloud, SaaS, IT Services).
* Basic understanding of U.S. GAAP.
* Exposure to corporate income tax, sales and use tax, and other state and local tax matters.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Compensation: Base salary of $80,000 \- $95,000, depending on experience, plus eligibility for a discretionary semi\-annual bonus.
* High\-visibility, high\-impact role with ownership of key finance and business operations processes.
* Excellent benefits package including 100% company\-paid Gold PPO Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and short\-term disability and long\-term disability insurance.
* 401k with employer matching, wellness perks, and birthday PTO.
* Supportive team culture with global reach and startup agility.
* Opportunities for career growth across finance, FP\&A, or business operations tracks.

**Ready to make an impact at a leader in cloud technology? Apply today.**

*Bespin Global US is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00

VML's global network spans 55\+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.



VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.



For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn \#WeAreVML.

**What you'll need:**


* **5\+ years of hands\-on project management and program delivery experience in an advertising or marketing communications firm, ideally at for a large Health/Pharma client account.**

jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



Optimum is a communications and media company that enables our customers through the power of connectivity. With a relentless focus on challenging today's norm while developing the telecommunications of the future, our products and services bring people closer together and connect them to the things that matter most to them, faster and more easily than ever before. To meet the needs of our customers, Optimum is building a company and a workforce that is equipped to deliver on the Optimum promise. That means creating an environment that attracts and retains the best talent and reflects the ideas, perspective and backgrounds of the diverse communities and people we serve across the country. Optimum believes that great ideas and the opportunity to deliver for our customers should come from every member of our team. And when our make\-up and mindset reflect that of the world in which we live, we're all the stronger for it.


The Project Manager in the Data \& Analytics department is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering data and analytics initiatives using Agile methodologies. This role partners with business stakeholders, scrum masters, data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, and technology teams to ensure projects deliver measurable business value on time, within scope, and with appropriate quality and governance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* The Project Manager will be directly responsible for managing/overseeing project: scope, cost, schedule, risks/issues, procurement and communications.
* Apply Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid Agile approaches based on project and team needs.
	+ Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including:
	+ Scrum of scrum
	+ PI planning
	+ Portfolio syncs
	+ PI retrospectives
* Partner with 3rd party suppliers and internal stakeholders including scrum masters, data engineers, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to define priorities, quarterly commitments, success measures and dependencies.
* Identify, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers impacting commitments made by the scrum teams.
* Develop, maintain and communicate PI plans, roadmaps and benefits to stakeholders including executives.
* Track delivery of scrum teams using Agile metrics such as sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and delivery predictability.
* Create project procurement management plans detailing what needs, quantities, and timelines are required for renewals and new contracts with procurement.
* Monitor supplier performance, manage day\-to\-day vendor relationships, and resolve delivery issues.
* Track spending against the project budget and report financial variances early.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* PMP, PMI\-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PSM, SAFe, or similar certification
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting technology, data or analytics initiatives
* Demonstrated experience working in an Agile environment using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid methodologies
* Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams and complex project dependencies
* Experience with project and Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem\-solving
* Key Competencies
	+ Agile project delivery
	+ Stakeholder and vendor management
	+ Planning and prioritization
	+ Risk and dependency management
	+ Facilitation and conflict resolution
	+ Executive communication
	+ Continuous improvement
	+ Outcome and value\-focused delivery
* Success Measures / KPIs
	+ On\-time, on\-budget and predictable delivery of data and analytics initiatives
	+ Achievement of project objectives and business outcomes
	+ Sprint and program increment predictability
	+ Reduction of delivery risks and blockers
	+ Stakeholder satisfaction
	+ Adoption and usage of delivered analytics solutions
	+ Improvement in team velocity, cycle time, and delivery efficiency


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

Spry Methods is seeking a Program Manager to provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of a large, technically diverse IT and cybersecurity program. The Program Manager will direct contractor and subcontractor personnel, oversee program performance, and ensure all requirements are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with contract requirements. This position serves as the primary management interface between Spry and Government stakeholders and must have the authority to make decisions and commit company resources in response to program needs.



### **What Your Day\-To\-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities):**


* Provide overall management, direction, administration, quality control, and leadership for contractor and subcontractor personnel.
* Ensure IT and cybersecurity activities align with mission requirements and strategic objectives.
* Manage program scope, staffing, schedule, cost, resources, risks, performance, and deliverables.
* Establish and maintain program governance, performance tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder communication processes.
* Oversee staffing and manpower requirements across diverse technical skill sets and labor categories.
* Monitor financial and operational performance using established metrics and reporting.
* Develop and maintain the Program Management Plan, Stakeholder Communication Plan, Risk Management Plan, staffing matrix, organizational chart, and supporting procedures.
* Coordinate Government and contractor communications and provide timely visibility into technical, contractual, personnel, resource, and programmatic risks.
* Lead program meetings, including kickoff and monthly technical status meetings.
* Prepare and deliver monthly status reporting covering task progress, staffing, risks, corrective actions, schedules, travel, and required Government actions.
* Manage quality assurance and ensure contract deliverables meet applicable standards and requirements.
* Support transition\-in and transition\-out planning, knowledge transfer, workforce continuity, and surge requirements.
* Ensure required personnel training, certifications, security requirements, and workforce documentation remain current.
* Assist the Government with applicable financial and business processes without performing inherently governmental functions.
### **What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements):**


* TS/SCI clearance eligibility.
* Active Project Management Professional certification.
* At least 10 years of experience managing a project or program of similar size and complexity.
* At least five years of experience overseeing and determining manpower requirements for programs involving diverse technical skill sets and labor categories.
* At least five years of experience performing financial and performance monitoring of contracts, including the use of performance metrics.
* Demonstrated authority to make organizational decisions, commit company resources, and respond to Government concerns and program requirements.
### **Ideally, You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications):**


* Experience managing large DoW IT, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, DevSecOps, or enterprise modernization programs.
* Experience managing geographically distributed personnel, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Familiarity with the Risk Management Framework, Authorization to Operate processes, DoW cybersecurity requirements, and DoW 8140 workforce compliance.
* Experience overseeing firm\-fixed\-price programs with formal deliverables, service\-level requirements, and performance metrics.
* Experience managing program transitions, staffing continuity, risk management, and customer communications

* Demonstrated experience working in an Agile environment using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid methodologies

* Experience with project and Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco North America is seeking a **Program \& Data Analyst** to provide programmatic, analytical, and operational support to **Team Submarine** for a major U.S. Navy modernization and sustainment program at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, D.C.

  



**Must be able to obtain/maintain/transfer a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**

  



In this role, you will serve as a key contributor supporting program execution, stakeholder coordination, data analysis, and reporting across U.S. Navy and Department of Defense organizations. You will transform complex data into meaningful insights by collecting, validating, analyzing, and presenting information that enables informed, data\-driven decision\-making and supports successful program outcomes.


The successful candidate will provide senior leadership with objective, data\-informed information and recommendations supporting decisions related to program execution, organizational effectiveness, and management operations. You will compile, maintain, verify, and interpret data using established organizational plans, policies, and independent judgment; perform in\-depth analyses to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and potential technical or management issues; and develop reports, recommendations, and support documentation for senior\-level review.


This position provides a unique opportunity to broaden your skill set and gain firsthand experience supporting **Team Submarine and the Directorate of Shipyard Submarine and Aircraft Carrier Modernization, Overhaul and Repair**. NAVSEA 04 provides continuous oversight and direction of complex shipyard repair and modernization projects, applying corporate project management concepts and practices to support the quantity and quality of work accomplished by assigned project teams.


The successful candidate will be seated **on\-site within SEA 04X1 at the Washington Navy Yard** and will work closely with Team Submarine, Navy leadership, program offices, shipyard stakeholders, and other internal and external organizations. ***This position is on\-site at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, D.C., five days per week, excluding federal holidays and other authorized absences. This is not a telework/hybrid position.***

In this role, you will:


* Compile, maintain, verify, interpret, and analyze program and operational data to support program execution and senior\-level decision\-making.
* Analyze large and complex data sets and develop data analytics and visualization tools to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and actionable insights.
* Provide data\-informed assessments, reporting, metrics, and program oversight to support senior leadership decisions.
* Develop, maintain, and manage recurring program metrics and dashboards, ensuring reporting requirements meet stakeholder needs.
* Analyze program requirements and develop reporting specifications, data\-gathering approaches, analytical techniques, metrics, and evaluation methodologies.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate activities supporting maintenance, modernization, and project execution.
* Conduct research and analysis and provide findings and recommendations to support leadership decision\-making.
* Lead or support studies, surveys, reviews, and research efforts to evaluate program accomplishments, effectiveness, performance, and compliance with established goals, objectives, policies, and regulations.
* Develop and maintain metrics, reporting methodologies, and evaluation tools to support program analysis and reporting.
* Prepare coordinated reports, presentations, executive briefings, talking papers, memoranda, correspondence, and decision packages in accordance with established policies and requirements.
* Coordinate stakeholder input and develop presentations, papers, and other materials supporting senior leadership direction, command projects, proposals, and initiatives.
* Develop program and management documentation outlining mission requirements, objectives, concepts of operation, strategic plans, and execution priorities.
* Consider whether this responsibility is required for the role or if the intent is to focus on supporting the Chief of Staff through program analysis, metrics, dashboards, reporting, and decision support.
* Analyze complex issues and present findings, recommendations, and support data to leadership.
* Plan and coordinate stakeholder engagements and collaborative efforts in support of program and mission priorities.
* Create and manage communications for enterprise, group, and individual stakeholders, including meeting agendas, executive briefs, action items, and follow\-up activities.
* Develop recurring and ad hoc reports on significant program activities and assess the effectiveness of events, processes, and initiatives.
* Organize and facilitate internal and external communications across a wide range of activities, including program reviews, meetings, command\-level events, congressional engagements, invitations, speaking engagements, and resource coordination.
* Maintain awareness of command vision, mission, leadership intent, program priorities, and relevant issues affecting Navy, DoD, and associated stakeholder organizations.
* Exercise independent judgment in planning and accomplishing assignments while effectively managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Collaborate as part of an integrated team and as required, lead or coordinate the work of others.
* Perform additional analytical and programmatic tasks in support of mission priorities.

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** UAE / India  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 6 Years  
**Level:** Senior / Team Lead / Project Lead

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior Developer cum Project Manager** who combines strong hands\-on software development capabilities with proven experience in **Digital Twin projects**.

Mandatory Requirement

**Previous hands\-on experience in a Digital Twin project is compulsory.**

Candidates without Digital Twin implementation/development experience are requested **not to apply**.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate must have:

* Minimum **6 years of professional software development experience**
* Proven experience working on **Digital Twin projects**
* Previous responsibility as a **Team Leader, Technical Lead, or Project Lead**
* Strong hands\-on development background — this is **not a purely managerial position**
* Ability to understand customer requirements and convert them into technical architecture, development tasks, and implementation plans
* Experience managing developers, integration teams, vendors, and project deliverables
* Excellent communication and **presentation skills**
* Confidence in presenting technical solutions, architecture, project status, and demonstrations directly to customers and senior stakeholders
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capabilities

Technical Background – Either of the Following

**Option 1 – Senior Backend Developer**

Strong experience in:

* Backend application development
* REST APIs / Web Services
* API integration and middleware
* Databases and data architecture
* Real\-time / near\-real\-time data integration
* Third\-party system integration
* Cloud and/or on\-premise deployment
* Integration of Digital Twin platforms with external systems

**OR**

**Option 2 – Senior AI/ML Developer**

Strong experience in:

* AI/ML development
* Computer Vision and/or Vision AI
* LLM / Generative AI integration
* Data analytics and predictive models
* AI API development and integration
* Integration of AI capabilities within Digital Twin environments

Digital Twin Experience

Candidates should have practical exposure to Digital Twin projects involving one or more of the following:

**3D Digital Twin \| IoT \| BMS \| CCTV \| Access Control \| Facilities Management \| Smart Buildings \| Smart Cities \| Asset Monitoring \| Real\-Time Data \| AI Analytics \| Predictive Analytics \| API/Middleware Integration \| Command \& Control Platforms**

Experience with **Unreal Engine, Unity, NVIDIA Omniverse, Azure Digital Twins, AWS IoT TwinMaker, or similar Digital Twin/3D visualization platforms** will be an advantage.

Project Leadership Responsibilities

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Lead Digital Twin projects from technical design through implementation
* Coordinate development, AI, 3D, API, infrastructure, and integration teams
* Prepare solution architecture and integration strategy
* Manage project plans, milestones, dependencies, and technical risks
* Conduct customer meetings, technical workshops, and presentations
* Coordinate with third\-party vendors for API and system integrations
* Review development quality and ensure timely delivery
* Participate hands\-on in development and technical problem\-solving when required
* Manage UAT, deployment, commissioning, documentation, and handover

IMPORTANT – PLEASE APPLY ONLY IF

You have **6\+ years of professional development experience**, have previously worked as a **Team Lead/Project Lead**, and have **actual Digital Twin project experience**.

Candidates with only project management experience and **no strong development background will not be considered**.

Candidates with strong development experience but **no Digital Twin project exposure will also not be considered**.

**If you are a hands\-on senior technologist who can develop, lead a technical team, manage a Digital Twin project, and confidently present solutions to customers, we would like to hear from you.**
